name: maktab-timetable
description: Maktab Timetable desktop product and future school platform monorepo

scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run wait-and-start-electron:desktop"
scripts.dev:browser: concurrently -k "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:platform-api"
scripts.dev:platform-api: uv run --package maktab-platform-api python services/platform-api/manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000
scripts.dev:worker: uv run --package maktab-platform-api celery -A config.celery worker --loglevel=info --workdir services/platform-api/src
scripts.wait-and-start-electron: wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 http://127.0.0.1:4000/local-api/v1/health http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/health/ready && npm run dev:electron
scripts.platform:migrate: uv run --package maktab-platform-api python services/platform-api/manage.py migrate
scripts.platform:seed: uv run --package maktab-platform-api python services/platform-api/manage.py seed_development
scripts.platform:schema: uv run --package maktab-platform-api python services/platform-api/manage.py spectacular --file services/platform-api/openapi.yaml --validate
scripts.test:release: uv run --package maktab-release-api pytest --rootdir=services/release-api -c services/release-api/pytest.ini services/release-api/tests
scripts.check:release: uv run --package maktab-release-api ruff check services/release-api/src services/release-api/tests && uv run --package maktab-release-api python services/release-api/manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run && npm run test:release
scripts.release:migrate: uv run --package maktab-release-api python services/release-api/manage.py migrate
scripts.release:create-license: uv run --package maktab-release-api python services/release-api/manage.py create_license
scripts.release:revoke-license: uv run --package maktab-release-api python services/release-api/manage.py revoke_license
scripts.release:reset-device: uv run --package maktab-release-api python services/release-api/manage.py reset_license_device
scripts.release:cleanup: uv run --package maktab-release-api python services/release-api/manage.py cleanup_release_state
scripts.test: npm test --workspace=services/local-api && npm test --workspace=apps/web && npm run test:platform
scripts.check: npm run type-check --workspace=apps/web && uv run --package maktab-platform-api ruff check services/platform-api && npm run test
scripts.check:desktop-security: npm run check:desktop-js && npm run test:desktop-main
scripts.check:data-safety: npm run test:migrations && npm run test:backup-recovery && node --test apps/desktop/test/ipc-contracts.test.js apps/desktop/test/ipc.test.js
scripts.lint:solver: uv run --package maktab-timetable-solver ruff check services/timetable-solver && uv run --package maktab-timetable-solver ruff format --check services/timetable-solver
scripts.check:solver: npm run lint:solver && npm run test:solver && npm run test:solver-reliability
scripts.check:desktop: npm run check:dependencies && npm run check:desktop-security && npm run type-check --workspace=apps/web && npm test --workspace=apps/web && npm test --workspace=services/local-api && npm run check:data-safety && npm run test:local-reliability && npm run check:solver && npm run check:release
scripts.build:all: npm run build:web && npm run build:api && npm run build:solver

author: Maktab Platform Team
